Group I [ edit ] Venue: Complexo de tenis do Jamor, Oeiras , Portugal (Clay) Date: 8-13 April 2024 The twelve teams were divided into three pools of four teams. The winners of each pool are promoted to the 2024 Billie Jean King Cup Play-offs and will compete in a round-robin to determine final positions. Second-placed teams played for the fourth promotion spot. Third-placed teams played for overall position. Fourth-placed teams played for 10th place and last two teams were relegated.
